profile.headline: Senior Embedded Systems Software Engineer at Avid Technology

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Developed productivity applications for various local businesses including time-share resorts and real-estate firms using C# and SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description: Designed and implemented malware detection system for a Web Service. GUI portions developed in C# and C++/MFC. Windows system level tools for low-level detection developed in base Win32 and WMI using C++. Created modular testing system with IronPython.  Algorithms for testing written in Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed embedded operating system for audio signal processing devices using a Motorola Coldfire processor for managing DSP resources and host communications. Developed using Diab C/C++ compilers, Nucleus, VxWorks, and eCos Real Time Operating System.  Debugging done with EST suite of hardware and software tools.

Designed embedded operating system for Digital Signal Processing (DSP) using Motorola DSP56000 processors to allow dynamic execution of code for processing multiple algorithms on multiple channels of audio.  Developed using Motorola assembler.

Designed GUI software for system monitoring and control of signal processing devices over RS232/485 and Ethernet TCP/IP.  Developed for Windows 95/98/NT using Microsoft Visual C++.  Made extensive use of ActiveX, COM, ATL, and MFC technologies to implement Plug-in style software modules.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Developed Windows GUI accounting assistant software for Telemarketing firm using Microsoft Visual C++.

Debugged and optimized embedded operating system in Motorola 65000 assembly language used by photo development machines to read bar codes from processed film.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed embedded operating system for relaxation therapy pods using Intel 80C196 and Micron PIC16C5X RISC processors.  Developed using Motorola C and assembly compilers and Micron assembly compiler.  Tasks included LCD and keypad user interface to control lighting, temperature, sounds, and scents, RS232/485 communications for system monitoring and control, and single-wire communications for inter-processor synchronization and control.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) system for controlling various devices used for ground water remediation.  Developed using ladder logic programming tools.

Designed GUI software for system monitoring, control, and logging of remediation site over RS232/485 and telephone modem.  Developed for DOS and Windows using Borland C/C++ compiler and Microsoft Visual Basic.

positions.title: Aviation Electronics Specialist
positions.description: Maintained and repaired computerized test bench and Electronics Counter Measures (ECM) suite of avionics for F-14, F/A-18, A-6, and A-7 aircraft.  Held a secret security clearance.
